| [CASE-182](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-182.md) v2 | Two operators under one grant rule | Filed by the fourth status review ([ADR-057](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-057.md)) for [CLAIM-277](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-277.md), whose two loops the record had stated and not constructed. The new core had 2.9 ± 4.8 periphery-to-core links. With a random half of the core deleted, 8.8 ± 0.8 periphery units joined the 8.5 survivors. With every weight given to the core cut to 10⁻³ of its value, the core's own members made up 92% of the core 10⁶ steps later. The differentiation recovers. K linear operators, identical in form and differing only by initialization, mix by context-conditioned shares. Four rules update the shares: ordinary mixture-of-experts gating (the baseline), the same gating with a load-balancing loss, the same gating with a usage bias, and a multiplicative rule driven by the collective's loss minus the operator's own. Training follows influence. Each rule was run with K = 4 (no spare operator) and K = 6 (two spare), in 6 seeds, followed by eleven test arms. Every rule differentiated, with a distinct specialist for the rare context in 6 of 6 seeds. With K = 4, participation and performance matched across three rules. A rare specialist made rare (share 10⁻³, frozen) recovered in 6 of 6 seeds under all four rules. Under the multiplicative rule its growth rate did not depend on how rare it was made. Under gradient gating it fell with the share, and from 10⁻⁵ the specialist did not recover within the window. A usage bias recovered it from any share, but also raised an incompetent copy to 0.19. With K = 6, a removed specialist was replaced by a spare in 6 of 6 seeds under every rule. A suppressed specialist then failed to return in 23 of 24 rule-seed pairs per arm, whether its training had been decoupled from its influence and whether it had kept its competence. With K = 4, nothing replaced a removed specialist. A suppressed one returned every time, even after weight decay had cost it most of its competence and with its parameters frozen.
